findings.summary: The merge doesn't check that customer_id is unique in segments, so a duplicated customer has their orders joined twice and revenue is silently double-counted (suggest validate="many_to_one").

judge.reason: Describes join on customer_id duplicating orders because segments has multiple rows per customer, double-counting revenue; same defect (though framed as duplicate customers rather than monthly rows).

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Using how="inner" silently drops orders whose customer has no row in segments, making segment totals lower than total revenue with no warning (suggest a left join with an "unknown" segment or an explicit unmatched-row check).

judge.reason: Inner join dropping unmatched orders is a listed known problem.

findings.label: valid_other
